$comment: Sequences of writes replayed through Engine/TextRouter (RoutingCorpusChecks). A step sets the frame `f` and the time `t` (seconds), then one of: `write` (the game sets the text), `append` (the game reads what the component holds — our output in its shown form — and writes it back with more), `refresh` (what the component holds is set again, as the scanner's sweep does), `tick` (the stabiliser runs), `arrive` (a translation comes back for `o`). `shows` is what a person reads on the component after the step (the logical text behind a presented form). `queued` is everything sent for translation, in order. `present: rtl` presents right-to-left text as the flagged branch of RtlPresenter does. `file` holds source → translation, numbers written as [!v*N] where the file would. See analyse/banc-routage-texte.md (root).
